review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: The given bar graph illustrates how many US's males and females decided to opt for six main subjects at them a US university in 2010.

Overall, regardless of gender, Finance and Engine are the subjects students following the most and opposite respectively. Also of the note is that, the number between males and female students choosing Economics and Maths had a big gap.

To elaborate, there are 225 students chose opting for Finance in both of males and females and make Finance is the most attractive subject in six main subjects. With Marketing and Accounting, there were more attractive with girls with 120 and 200 than boys with 80 and 170 respectively.

Regarding categories with lower data for females, the number of male students choosing Economics and Mathematics is dramatically higher than with a gap of 75 and 140 respectively. With Engineering, there are 51 female students and 52 male students choose it and it had the less figures students following in six subjects.

completion.comment: Em đã viết đủ mở bài, Overview và hai Detail.

review.overall: Em nhóm số liệu đúng và các so sánh chính xác: Marketing 120/80, Accounting 200/170, khoảng cách Economics 75 và Mathematics 140. Tuy nhiên, Overview cần chỉ rõ Mathematics có khoảng cách lớn nhất, còn mở bài không được suy sinh viên đều là người Hoa Kỳ. Lỗi ghép động từ lặp ở there are ... chose, make Finance is và there are ... choose khiến nhiều câu khó đọc dù số liệu đúng. Em cần sửa và viết lại, giữ dữ kiện cùng cách nhóm của mình.

paragraphs: The given bar graph illustrates how many male and female students decided to opt for six main subjects at a university in the United States in 2010.

Overall, regardless of gender, Finance and Engineering were the most and least popular subjects respectively for both genders. Also of note is that Economics and Mathematics had substantial gaps between male and female enrolment, with the gap in Mathematics being the largest.

To elaborate, around 225 male students and the same number of female students chose Finance, making Finance the most attractive of the six main subjects. Marketing and Accounting were more popular among female than male students, with female figures of 120 and 200 compared with 80 and 170 for males respectively.

Regarding categories with lower data for females, the numbers of male students choosing Economics and Mathematics were much higher than the corresponding female figures, with gaps of 75 and 140 respectively. In Engineering, around 51 female students and 52 male students chose the subject and these were the lowest figures among the six subjects.

Đối chiếu phần sau higher than với vở rồi đọc trọn câu còn lại sau gạch.
